d:
Hi :) This is the third comic I've ever made, and I feel like I'm slowly getting better. Your feedback helps a lot, so if you liked it, great! If not, please tell me what I could do better.

I've also started a Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/ReGenPro

You don't need to subscribe to read my comics. I'll release every comic here too, in parts. Patreon is for anyone who wants to support me and read new comics before
